phase.demoCaption: Live demo from the AZES design system.
phase.dialogBody: Modal surface uses theme elevation and z-index tokens.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.caption: Tokens, type, space, motion
foundations.body: The language under every surface — color seeds, typography, spacing, shape, elevation, and motion.
foundations.lookFor: Watch how tokens cascade into controls without one-off hex values.
foundations.pullQuote: Tokens cascade — no one-off hex on the path to controls.

controls.title: Controls
controls.caption: Buttons, fields, surfaces
controls.body: Interactive building blocks — buttons, text fields, choice controls, cards, and accordion.
controls.lookFor: Focus rings, density, and primary vs outlined hierarchy.
controls.pullQuote: Hierarchy is the product: focus, density, primary vs outlined.

data.title: Data & feedback
data.caption: Lists, alerts, dialogs
data.body: How AZES shows data and talks back — tables, lists, avatars, tooltips, alerts, snackbars, dialogs.
data.lookFor: Empty states, severity tones, and modal vs snackbar timing.
data.pullQuote: Feedback has timing — empty, severity, modal vs snack.

shell.title: Shell & nav
shell.caption: Layout, tabs, chrome
shell.body: Page structure and wayfinding — Container/Grid/Stack, app shell, responsive rules, tabs, breadcrumbs, menus.
shell.lookFor: How chrome and content share the scoop scrollport.
shell.pullQuote: Chrome and content share one scoop — not two scroll worlds.

platform.title: Platform
platform.caption: Engines, table, charts, pages
platform.body: Product engines and recipes — settings, navigation, form binding, AzesTable, charts, and sample pages.
platform.lookFor: How platform packages compose into real screens (auth page stays out of the toolbar).
platform.pullQuote: Packages compose into screens — engines before one-offs.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.empty: Ask about azes-ui, or say “switch to dark mode”.
ai.errorNoKey: AI is not configured (NVIDIA_API_KEY missing on the server).
ai.errorRate: Too many requests — wait a moment and retry.
ai.errorOffline: Network error — check that the showcase dev server is running.

colors.caption: OKLCH seeds, semantic status, and tinted surfaces.

typography.caption: Token-mapped MUI type scale from h1 to overline.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.caption: theme.spacing steps — one spacing engine only.

radius.title: Shape
radius.caption: Corner radii from design-token shape primitives.

shadows.title: Elevation
shadows.caption: Custom shadow ladder for cards and chrome.

motion.title: Motion
motion.caption: Duration and easing tokens for UI transitions.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.caption: Contained, outlined, and text hierarchies.
buttons.intro: Contained / outlined / text hierarchy, sizes, disabled, ButtonGroup, Chip, and Link.
buttons.takeaway: Pick one primary action per view; keep outlined and text for secondary paths.

inputs.title: Text fields
inputs.caption: Labels, helpers, and validation states.
inputs.intro: Outlined TextField state matrix — default, focused hint, error, disabled, and read-only.
inputs.takeaway: Helper and error copy must name the problem; never rely on color alone.

fields.focusedHelper: Tab here to see the primary focus ring

forms.title: Choice controls
forms.caption: Checkbox, radio, switch, and denser rows.
forms.intro: Choice controls, Select, Slider, and ToggleButton — primary color and density-aware.
forms.takeaway: Group choices tightly; open a dialog only when Autocomplete needs more space.

dialog.title: Autocomplete dialog
dialog.body: Small modal with a text field and Autocomplete — same pattern product forms use.
dialog.name: Display name

cards.title: Card
cards.caption: Outlined and elevated surface recipes side by side.
cards.intro: Outlined (default) versus elevated cards — same content, different emphasis.
cards.takeaway: Prefer outlined in dense lists; elevate only when the card is the interaction focus.
cards.surfaceBody: Cards use background.paper from the semantic tokens.
cards.whenNote: Outlined for quiet grouping; elevated (customShadows.card) when the card must lift from the canvas.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.caption: AzesAccordion search and CRUD panels with token padding.
accordion.intro: Product convention: AzesAccordion — bordered, no elevation, density-aware header height.
accordion.takeaway: Use search mode above tables; CRUD for short create/edit — not long wizards.
